$comment: Sighter's CI contract (scripts/affected.mjs, .gitea/actions/app-gates, ADR 0014 §6; the field list is in .gitea/actions/README.md): a Linux leg of ci.yml for the pure core (crates/sighter-core): fmt, clippy, nextest, doc tests and deny, plus `rustChecks`: the coverage gate (cargo llvm-cov, 99 % of lines, as Pitwall's core). The core has no OS-specific code yet, so there are no Windows or macOS legs; the capture and input adapters add them. There is no UI, installer or release yet. `checks`: the ONNX Runtime pipeline scripts (scripts/ort, stage-2 plan SW5): shellcheck, their tests on synthetic fixtures, the shared byte and import checks they call (conformance/release/telemetry-bytes.mjs, windows-crt-imports.mjs), and cargo check and clippy of the smoke program, which links ONNX Runtime only in sighter-ort.yml.
rustChecks: cargo llvm-cov nextest -p sighter-core -p sighter-target --profile ci --summary-only --fail-under-lines 99
